scope: LUDUS application mapping against the consolidated GARP 2.7 r2 reference master. This does not claim school-server or LIVE certification.

findings.reason: Reference ASSURANCE derives overall from required components and trusted evidence. LUDUS does not self-declare LIVE PASS; server-dependent evidence stays NOT_TESTED.
Reference AUTO-PATCH requires a non-empty trusted gate set; LUDUS does not implement a competing application-local COMMITTED authority.
Reference AUTO-PATCH binds source, target digests, trusted evidence and replay sequence to expectations outside the candidate.
Policy, app profile, capability inventory and LIVE status have distinct semantics. Missing school runtime is DEFERRED/NOT_TESTED, not PASS.
Current authority is explicitly GARP 2.7. GARP 2.5.1 remains byte-locked historical regression tooling and is not relabeled.
Conditional production runtime tests require machine-readable approval, allowlisted dedicated target and hard limits. LUDUS distributes no active production red-team runner.
Reference output separates PACKAGE_SELFTEST, CONTRACT_TEST, APP behavior and LIVE. Legacy 81/81 remains regression tooling evidence only.
LUDUS foundation policy uses inventory-valid app identity, semver and recognized semantic fields in every required section; mode-only and placeholder policies are rejected by the r2 validator.
